recipient_key_fingerprint_sha256.preimage: UTF-8 bytes of the canonical age recipient string, with no added newline or other normalization

encrypted_artifact_sha256.preimage: exact ciphertext bytes of the external age artifact

limitation: This runtime does not implement or decrypt age and cannot prove that ciphertext corresponds to staged plaintext. Matching profile identifiers and the ciphertext SHA-256 are a strict external attestation boundary, not cryptographic verification by this runtime.
note: v3 scoring suites accept only profile_id age-x25519-v1. Development and validation artifacts must remain plaintext staging with externally_encrypted_artifact_bound=false. Test must bind an external age-x25519-v1 artifact with externally_encrypted_artifact_bound=true.
